title: CI/CD Pipeline Builder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Learners choose the automated actions for the build, test, and deploy stages of a story library pipeline, avoiding manual steps and skipped tests, and see the pipeline drawn as a flow.

learningObjectives: Design a CI/CD pipeline by selecting appropriate stages (build, test, deploy) and defining the automated actions for each stage.
prerequisites: Story CI/CD and Story Build and Deploy sections of Chapter 15

keyQuestions: Design a CI/CD pipeline by selecting appropriate stages (build, test, deploy) and defining the automated actions for each stage.
assessmentOpportunities: All three stages contain only the automated actions and nothing manual.
Learner can explain why rollback matters for frequent releases.
